title: Sort the weekly leaderboard by score
description: Refactors the leaderboard sort helper and wires it into the endpoint that returns the top players of the week.

expected.note: Scores are numbers but they are compared as strings, so they sort lexicographically: 100 comes before 9 and long scores land in the wrong place. Compare numerically, e.g. `b.score - a.score` for the intended high-to-low order.
